notes: v1.11.0 adds the limited public Achievements experience under Season: sanitized public AP/CP standings, selectable team unlock details, no locked/catalog exposure, and resilient Supabase cache/retry behavior.

v1.10.24 replaces static in-game team projections with a live revised-final estimate: pregame players keep their weekly baseline, completed players contribute actual final points, and active players contribute actual points plus only the unplayed share of their pregame projection. Player-level live score parentheses use the same model.
v1.10.8 fixes startup draft-utility visibility initialization by using the active LIVE_SEASON_BUILD flag instead of the removed FORCE_POST_DRAFT flag.
v1.10.5 simplifies live score-plus-projection displays to compact `actual (projection)` formatting with no `proj` label.
v1.10.7 immediately refreshes Sleeper and live season API data on startup whenever a saved team is available, while keeping first paint non-blocking.

v1.10.6 fixes Other League Matchups LIVE label spacing and makes the Season GameDay banner fall back to each scheduled kickoff through roughly four hours after kickoff when live status is missing or delayed.

v1.10.4 keeps live actual scoring primary while retaining the latest available Sleeper projected final points in parentheses across matchup and lineup scoring displays; live-season sync also refreshes projections once scoring is present.

v1.10.1 removes developer/validation-style Settings UI: the Package Check / Season Data readiness card and the Historical Results integrity card. Underlying historical correction, validation, backup, connection, and season data systems remain intact.

v1.9.72 adds Other League Matchups under Weekly Matchup Center with compact projected/live totals and an on-demand matchup detail dialog, and updates health-driven major-need floors to QB <=1, RB <=2, WR <=3 usable when designations are present.
v1.9.48 removes the redundant Current Sleeper Lineup card from Season while preserving matchup/lineup data for Bench Analysis, Matchup Center, Weekly Action Brief, and other intelligence.

v1.9.47 applies the Bench Analysis percentage thresholds to ordinary waiver/add-drop upgrades in both Weekly Action Brief and Season Add / Drop Suggestions (QB 10%; RB/WR/TE 20%; TE over WR in FLEX 40%), while preserving injury-driven Major Roster Needs recommendations.

v1.9.47 updates the Color Theme subtitle, routes the Live Season Roster Watch action to My Team, moves Roster Pressure from Season to the bottom of My Team, and removes the redundant Season Roster Health card.

v1.9.45 makes Season health/depth displays use health-aware usable-player counts, confirms Questionable is unavailable for Major Roster Needs, and applies position-specific bench-over-starter projection thresholds (QB 10%; RB/WR/TE/K/DEF 20%; TE over a WR in FLEX 40%).
v1.9.44 makes the Report Card draft-complete banner theme-aware and moves the Trade Partner theme accent from the surrounding selector section onto the actual team select control.

v1.9.43 extends color-theme coverage to Season Intelligence, neutral roster-need/depth chips, standings playoff separator, Teams informational tendency chips, and other decorative informational blue accents while preserving semantic colors.
v1.9.42 removes the Navigation, Weekly Workspace, and Refresh Behavior cards from Settings; Command Center remains the fixed default landing page.
v1.9.42 adds persistent UCL Blue, Forest, Purple, Crimson, Orange, and Slate color themes using global design tokens while preserving semantic colors.
v1.9.41 reorganizes Settings around the full Live Season Companion: Appearance, General, Season, Draft & Report Card, Sleeper & Data, and Reset & Maintenance.
Draft-only preferences are demoted into a collapsed Archived Draft Preferences section while UCL Blue is established as the current Appearance theme foundation for v1.9.42.

v1.9.40 adds position-specific color framing to Player Acquisition cards while keeping player rows neutral white: QB salmon, WR light blue, RB light green, TE medium orange, K light purple, DEF light brown.
v1.9.39 removes the in-app Waiver Watchlist, compacts the empty Analytics / Season Positional Context card, and corrects Playoff Machine week-card padding and outcome-button tap targets.

v1.9.38 repairs the v1.9.37 empty-state CSS block and collapses empty League Activity, CTESPN Newsroom, and CTESPN Weekly League Report cards to title + message only with identical message typography.
v1.9.37 renames the Players screen header to Player Acquisition and replaces the availability disclaimer with user-facing Free Agency / Waivers guidance.
Playoff Machine week cards use reduced container padding while W/L/? scenario buttons are approximately 40% wider and 20% taller for easier tapping.
Empty League Activity, CTESPN Newsroom, and CTESPN Weekly League Report cards collapse to compact message-only states until content exists.
v1.9.36 lazy-loads missing remaining regular-season matchup weeks only when Postseason / Playoff Machine is prepared or enters the viewport; ordinary Season navigation remains render-only.
v1.9.34 replaces the Season status line with Your guide to NFL Week [week].
UCL Bowl Series Notes now include the winning and losing scores plus the season year.
Rivalry history excludes 0-0 matchup rows from API, imported, and current-season sources so unplayed placeholder weeks cannot create false ties or points.
v1.9.34 uses a new rivalry-history cache generation so previously cached 0-0 placeholder games are not reused.
v1.9.33 swaps the main-menu positions of Players and Trade Center and renames FA/W to Players.
Championship rivalry tagging now requires the verified winners-bracket p=1 pairing and the exact championship playoff week, preventing other meetings between the same teams from inheriting the tag.
Championship badges receive additional width so the full CHAMPIONSHIP label remains visible on desktop and mobile.
UCL Bowl Series Notes include the bowl numeral using 2018 = UCL Bowl I, and scan the complete rivalry series even when the title game is older than Recent Meetings.
v1.9.33 uses a new rivalry-history cache generation so incorrect v1.9.32 championship flags are not reused.
v1.9.32 adds Season subsection navigation with lazy-on-demand section preparation.
Rivalry meetings mark only verified winners-bracket p=1 championship pairings with a championship tag; third-place and consolation/Toilet Bowl games remain unmarked.
Rivalry meeting margins now display as Margin: 42.90 PTS.
Series Notes are limited to a latest-meeting UCL Bowl result and never-beaten series cases.
Rivalry source wording no longer displays Sleeper archive + 2026.

v1.9.31 adds lazy API-backed historical rivalry retrieval when Rivalries & Season Archive is viewed, following Sleeper previous_league_id history back through 2018 and matching managers by stable owner/user IDs.
Rivalry historical API results are cached locally for seven days; ordinary startup and tab navigation remain network-free.
Rivalry metrics now place Largest Margin beside Series so both team PF cards display side by side.
My Team now displays current injury designations beside affected players only on the My Team tab.
Major Roster Needs remains health-aware: QB/RB/WR with one or fewer healthy usable players becomes a major need and surfaces up to three suitable waiver alternatives.
v1.9.30 replaces Command Center Team Management with a compact Weekly Action Brief that answers what, if anything, should be done with the roster this week.
Weekly Action Brief reuses already-loaded Bench Analysis, waiver/depth, health, bye-week, and trade-route context; it makes no network or persistence calls and shows at most five prioritized actions.
When no action is active, the Weekly Action Brief uses the existing compact empty-card behavior to save Command Center space.
The former Team Management action button is renamed This Week and routes to the Season This Week section.
v1.9.28 completes the remaining Live Season calculation audit with render-scoped reuse in Season and Trade Center.
Season now computes one matchup scoring context per primary render and shares it with weekly watch, header scoring, matchup center, and lineup projection state.
Trade Center now precomputes rank distribution, roster ownership/counts, and positional scarcity once per render-scoped value context instead of rescanning league data for each player row.
No global long-lived cache, background request, persistence write, timer, or Sync behavior was added.
v1.9.27 audits My Team and Command Center repeated calculations without changing visible behavior or synchronization.
My Team now resolves each displayed player and weekly point value once per render and reuses those values for lineup rows and totals.
Command Center now shares one render-scoped roster-player cache across roster warnings and waiver-need analysis, eliminating duplicate metadata scans.
No global cache, timer, network request, persistence write, or Sync-path behavior was added.
v1.9.26 upgrades Trade Evaluation to package-adjusted scoring: elite/consolidated assets retain premium value while additional depth pieces receive diminishing lineup-slot weight.
Trade Evaluation II keeps raw 0–100 player values transparent, adds Package Out/Package In scores, preserves roster-construction adjustments, and does not add network or persistence activity.
v1.9.25 adds the requested dark-blue border to the Trade Partner selector container without changing Trade Center behavior or layout.
v1.9.23 compacts Trade Center presentation without changing trade logic, synchronization, or lazy secondary rendering.
Trade Center now uses tighter card spacing, shorter roster pickers, denser player rows, and a more compact evaluation surface on desktop and mobile.
Trade player text remains readable while removing the oversized v1.7.x responsive overrides that made the trade builder vertically excessive.
v1.9.22 reduces Trade Center and Report Card first-open work by deferring secondary below-the-fold analysis until after the primary view becomes interactive.
Trade Center immediately renders the builder/evaluation surface while Potential Trade Partners and Completed Trade Retrospectives render lazily as they approach the viewport.
Report Card immediately renders core grade/highlight/position/roster assessment content while Week 1 detail, league leaderboard, awards, strategy review, and final evaluation are deferred.
Report Card final evaluation now computes the Week 1 league projection table once per lazy render instead of recomputing it for both rank lookup and league length.
Lazy secondary work is scheduled after the opening frame; browsers without IntersectionObserver retain eager fallback behavior.

v1.9.21 replaces Matchup Intelligence II with focused Bench Analysis that compares eligible bench players against current starters using weekly projections; only starter threats and close calls within 2 points are shown.
Season Positional Context is preserved under a renamed Analytics section using finalized 2026 starter scoring.
v1.9.20 reduces Season first-open DOM/calculation pressure by lazy-rendering lower Team Management, Around the League, Postseason, and Records groups as they approach the viewport.
Season command shortcuts render the requested lazy group before scrolling without invoking season freshness/network synchronization.
Above-the-fold matchup, intelligence, lineup, health, and opponent context remain immediate; lower groups rerender only when visible after state/week changes.
v1.9.19 hardens saved-state persistence and audits the explicit Live Season Sync path after real-device crashes tied to bloated local data.
Weekly projection ingestion now batches and bounds discovered-player metadata, caches a compact projection payload, and never duplicates the discovered-player registry inside the runtime snapshot.
Oversized legacy discovered-player/local-mirror data is rejected before JSON parsing; the rebuildable discovered-player registry is capped at 220 records.
Live Season ↻ Sync now refreshes season data directly instead of refetching and reprocessing the completed draft first.
Normal season sync no longer fans out across all future matchup weeks; future weeks stay lazy-loaded, and historical backfill is limited to four missing weeks per sync.
Repeated runtime persistence requests are coalesced, and obsolete cached /players/nfl data is deleted without being read.
Modular source remains the canonical development source; standalone HTML is generated from this package.
v1.9.19 caps FA/W to the top 3 projected candidates per position before comparison/rendering to prevent oversized candidate lists and reduce mobile rendering pressure.
v1.9.17 audits every visible Live Season tab after a real-device Season freeze and makes tab rendering strictly read-only.
Season Waivers, FA/W, and Report Card no longer start projection synchronization simply because the view is opened.
Report Card strategy-history rendering no longer finalizes or persists strategy history; finalization remains in the explicit Sleeper sync path.
Settings no longer calls the removed production Diagnostics renderer.
Teams and other roster renderers keep sleeperRosterPlayer() as a read-only lookup; rendering never rewrites discovered-player persistence.
All shipped Diagnostics, regression suites, debug panels, API/cache status checks, and development verification controls remain removed.
Automatic startup Sleeper refresh, visibility/focus refresh, and polling remain disabled; the ↻ Sync button is the explicit live-data refresh path.
The archived Draft Board remains lazy-rendered during Live Season.
The app does not query Sleeper /players/nfl.
releaseNotes: v1.10.13 makes rivalry result orientation rename-safe by attributing historical scores through stable manager identity rather than literal current team names; this fixes renamed franchises such as dmercado → Leviathans without changing stored history or verified corrections.
v1.10.0 Stable promotes the validated v1.9.72 release candidate to the UCL Companion 1.10 stable release with no functional changes.
v1.9.72 adds Gold and Ice Blue themes. Ice Blue uses a cyan-forward palette.
v1.9.72 sorts My Team bench players by position (QB, RB, WR, TE, DEF, K), then by highest current-week projection or actual score within each position.
v1.9.72 changes user-facing roster-health wording from “secure” to “healthy”; health logic is unchanged.

v1.9.72 polishes Teams: adds Points Against beside Points For, replaces Roster # with League Rank, shortens Live season roster to Live Roster, and updates the League Teams subtitle to include the Draft Report Card.
v1.9.72 removes Report Card from the top-level navigation and promotes it to a prominent Teams-screen action while preserving the dedicated Report Card sub-page.

v1.9.72 locks the approved 2026 UCL Home/Away matrix into the Companion. Every team has 7 home/7 away games, every opponent pair reverses venue in its return meeting, and every team has a maximum home/away run of two. HOME uses green semantic pills and AWAY uses yellow across Command Center, Season matchup views, Other League Matchups, My Team, and Teams season results.

v1.9.72 raises the CTESPN dominance-story threshold: a one-sided series only becomes News when one team has at least 5 wins and the other has 0. Season Series Notes still report never-beaten records regardless of meeting count.

v1.9.72 limits CTESPN Newsroom to current + previous week, assigns real week numbers to transactions and playoff status stories, generates rivalry/dominance stories for every league matchup in the two-week window, and gives the longest-running series Lead Story priority when rivalry/dominance is the only news available.

v1.9.72 strengthens verified historical correction matching using Sleeper user identity plus username/display/team-name aliases, adds an inspectable historicalMatchupAudit path, bumps rivalry cache to v5, and surfaces the verified 2019 W10 result under Settings > Sleeper & Data.

v1.9.72 adds verified historical score corrections and identity-based historical matchup deduplication. The screenshot-verified 2019 W10 dmercado 140.47–fograw 138.51 result is authoritative, and same season/week/team-pair entries can no longer coexist merely because their scores differ.

v1.9.72 makes Sleeper custom_points authoritative over raw points for historical/current finalized matchup history and CTESPN result summaries, invalidates the old rivalry cache, and shows Longest Win Streak as start–end year or start–Present.

v1.9.72 upgrades the shared Season/News rivalry and dominance detail grid: Largest Blowout replaces Largest Margin; Largest Blowout, Highest-Scoring Meeting, Closest Matchup, and Last Meeting identify the winner; Longest Win Streak is the eighth metric.

v1.9.72 adds a 25% trailing-team win-share rivalry threshold with a weaker-team UCL Bowl victory exception; adds Closest Matchup to rivalry detail; and makes CTESPN rivalry/dominance stories tappable into a shared Season-level rivalry detail modal.
v1.9.72 fixes CTESPN Newsroom filter contrast: inactive buttons use dark text on white instead of inheriting global ghost-button white text; active buttons remain white on the theme/navy fill.
v1.9.72 fixes Newsroom filter contrast: inactive filters now use dark text on white, active filters use white text on the theme/navy fill, and hover states remain readable.
v1.9.72 fixes CTESPN Newsroom filter visibility: All, My Team, Games, Standings, Moves, and Rivalry are always rendered as a wrapping mobile-safe filter row.

v1.9.72 gives the News tab lazy rivalry-history access: it preflights only the selected team's current matchup, reuses the existing 7-day per-pair cache, fetches historical leagues only when needed, and rerenders CTESPN when history arrives.

v1.9.72 moves News, Results & Movement to a dedicated News tab before Command Center; adds News Story Filter/My Team; establishes rivalry rules (5 games, championship, or 3 seasons), excludes one-sided series from rivalry status, and generates a current-week first-win/dominance storyline instead.
v1.9.72 requires an established rivalry to be the actual current-week head-to-head matchup before CTESPN Newsroom generates a rivalry-renewal story.
v1.9.72 removes the visible 2026 Season Archive card from Season while preserving underlying archive/history data functions.
v1.9.72 makes Player Acquisition projection-difference text semantic: any positive delta is green, any negative delta is red, and exact ties are neutral regardless of selected theme.
v1.9.72 moves Package Check and Season Data readiness into Settings and removes developer-like Season Archive counters and package export controls.
v1.9.72 aligns Roster Watch, My Team Roster Pressure, and Season Weekly Watch with the precautionary Questionable vs actionable Doubtful/Out/reserve health model.

v1.9.72 consolidates Season waiver intelligence into Roster Needs & Moves and separates Questionable precautionary monitoring from actionable Doubtful/Out/reserve health needs; Weekly Action Brief uses the same distinction.
v1.9.48 removes the redundant Current Sleeper Lineup presentation card from Season.
